arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Falk argued the stops are criminal investigations of innocent people.
He stated the primary purpose is noncriminal investigation.
Ms. Millett argued the checkpoints are constitutional under prior rulings.
She cited cases involving alien smuggling and sobriety checks.
